title: Telemetry frame receipt
description: What the gateway answers for an accepted frame. The outcome says where the frame sat in its session's sequence, and lastAcceptedSequence is the resume point a reconnecting unit needs — a unit holding buffered frames can continue from there without resending what already arrived.

outcome.description: ACCEPTED: the expected frame, or the first of a session. DUPLICATE: this sequence was already seen, nothing is applied. OUT_OF_ORDER: behind the session's progress, applied per sensor only where the measurement is newer. GAP: ahead of the expected sequence, applied, with the missing range recorded.

receivedAt.description: When the gateway accepted the frame, which together with observedAt decides whether the measurement may prove a position.

lastAcceptedSequence.description: Highest sequence accepted for this unit across sessions. A late frame does not move it backwards.

missingFrames.description: How many sequence numbers were skipped. Present only when the outcome is GAP.
